================================================================================
rivet: generic call signatures separated by a newline in an interface
================================================================================

interface G {
  <K>(key: K): number
  <K extends string>(key: K): string
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (interface_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (interface_body
      (call_signature
        (type_parameters
          (type_parameter
            (type_identifier)))
        (formal_parameters
          (required_parameter
            (identifier)
            (type_annotation
              (type_identifier))))
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type)))
      (call_signature
        (type_parameters
          (type_parameter
            (type_identifier)
            (constraint
              (predefined_type))))
        (formal_parameters
          (required_parameter
            (identifier)
            (type_annotation
              (type_identifier))))
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type))))))

    string>
}

================================================================================
rivet: a less-than on a new line in expressions keeps its parse
================================================================================

a
<b>(c)
x
< y

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (expression_statement
    (call_expression
      (identifier)
      (type_arguments
        (type_identifier))
      (arguments
        (identifier))))
  (expression_statement
    (binary_expression
      (identifier)
      (identifier))))

  return
  <T>(x: T) => x
}
class A {
  m
  <T>() {}
}
let x: Map
<string, number> = y

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

================================================================================
rivet: export type star
================================================================================

export type * from './x'
export type * as ns from "./y";
export type * as "string name" from './z'
export * from './w'

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (export_statement
    (string
      (string_fragment)))
  (export_statement
    (namespace_export
      (identifier))
    (string
      (string_fragment)))
  (export_statement
    (namespace_export
      (string
        (string_fragment)))
    (string
      (string_fragment)))
  (export_statement
    (string
      (string_fragment))))

================================================================================
rivet: export type star without a source is an error
:error
================================================================================

export type *

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------



================================================================================
rivet: export type star as a namespace without a source is an error
:error
================================================================================

export type * as ns;

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------



================================================================================
rivet: export type star with a clause is an error
:error
================================================================================

export type * as ns, { a } from './x'

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------



================================================================================
rivet: TSX generic call signatures, export type star, and a JSX return
:language(tsx)
================================================================================

interface G {
  <K>(key: K): number
  <K>(key: K): string
}
export type * from './x'
function f() {
  return <div>
    <b />
  </div>
}
function g() {
  return
  <p />
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

(program
  (interface_declaration
    (type_identifier)
    (interface_body
      (call_signature
        (type_parameters
          (type_parameter
            (type_identifier)))
        (formal_parameters
          (required_parameter
            (identifier)
            (type_annotation
              (type_identifier))))
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type)))
      (call_signature
        (type_parameters
          (type_parameter
            (type_identifier)))
        (formal_parameters
          (required_parameter
            (identifier)
            (type_annotation
              (type_identifier))))
        (type_annotation
          (predefined_type)))))
  (export_statement
    (string
      (string_fragment)))
  (function_declaration
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters)
    (statement_block
      (return_statement
        (jsx_element
          (jsx_opening_element
            (identifier))
          (jsx_self_closing_element
            (identifier))
          (jsx_closing_element
            (identifier))))))
  (function_declaration
    (identifier)
    (formal_parameters)
    (statement_block
      (return_statement
        (jsx_self_closing_element
          (identifier))))))
